Privacy

eCash Card LLC · Last updated 28 October 2026

This site

ecashcard.org is static pages served by Cloudflare. The pages load one font and one stylesheet, both from this domain.

Cloudflare keeps request logs (your IP address, the page you asked for, your browser’s description of itself) for a short time to run its network, as described in Cloudflare’s privacy policy. eCash Card LLC sees only aggregate counts of visits.

Email

Mail to hi@ecashcard.org is read by the people who run eCash Card and kept as long as the conversation is useful. We answer from the same address.

The projects

Each project’s apps and sites have their own policy, which covers what that project records:

  • cashucard.org/privacy for Cashu Card and its provisioner app.
  • fedimintcard.org/privacy for Fedimint Card.

Questions

Write to hi@ecashcard.org.
